description: t.a is cancelled at 50, acknowledges (its sleep ends early, then a checkpoint with on_cancel continue) and begins cleanup, which waits on a Notify nobody signals. The drain never finishes: the run ends with t.a in the Cancelling phase, holding the driver's reason and the cleanup budget the cancellation granted it (poll quota and priority in the snapshot), not Running and not Completed. t.b, which runs no cleanup, completes.
